title: Business Analysis
description: D-77: the requirement path's AI §9.1 'Business Analysis — problem as understood, objectives, constraints; precedes all solution artifacts'. Rendered deterministically from the Stage 2 intent record and the Stage 3 context set — the problem exactly as the analysis understood it before any design was reasoned, with every objective, constraint and environmental fact carrying its provenance (FR-043) and every unknown listed with what would resolve it (FR-044). Nothing here is a conclusion; the standing says so. Repository-authored per docs/12 D-1, published to ARTIFACT_SCHEMA.

standing.description: What this document is: the problem as understood, stated before any solution artifact and not revised by one.

requested_outcome.description: D-90: Stage 2's reading of what the submitter wants back — part of the problem as understood. understanding_only is why a declined design has no solution artifact after this one.

decline_quote.description: D-90: the submitter's verbatim words declining a design; null unless requested_outcome is understanding_only.

constraints.description: Every context element of category `constraint` that is stated or inferred, with its provenance.

environment.description: Every stated or inferred context element of the other categories — environment, system, dependency, scale, objective — with its category and provenance.

unknowns.description: Every context element of provenance `unknown`, with what would resolve it (FR-044).
